help.title: How coslot works
help.intro: coslot connects owners of underused slots with people who need them — directly, without intermediaries.
help.step1Body: Discover available slots on the interactive map or switch to list view. Each pin is a real slot in the neighbourhood.
help.step2Body: Select the type of slot you need: storage, studio, outdoor or room. Sort by proximity, price or rating.
help.step3Body: Click on any slot to see photos, amenities, price and direct contact details for the owner.
help.step4Body: Have an unused unit, courtyard or room? Publish it in under 5 minutes and start receiving direct contacts.
help.mobileDesc: Tap any pin to see the slot. Use the floating button to switch between map and list view.
help.desktopDesc: The slot list appears on the right. On the left, the map updates in real time as you browse.
help.feature1Body: The heart on the corner of the image saves the space to your favourites list. Find them again from your profile.
help.feature2Body: The three-dot button opens options to report issues, claim ownership of the space, or contact it directly.
help.feature3Body: Once signed in you can leave a star rating and a comment. Spaces accumulate their average score.
help.feature4Body: From your profile you manage the spaces you have published and browse your saved favourites list.
